summary: Built the SC-001 Go project from an empty tree: config loader, possession-style migration runner and store, cookie and redirect helpers, GitHub OAuth flow (PKCE, state cookie), hashed sessions, the two-mount owner gate with the OwnerRoute interlock, the router and home/admin pages, a fake GitHub, and realMain. `go build` (CGO_ENABLED=0), `go vet` and `go test -count=1 ./...` pass across all 6 test packages, including TestBinary, which compiles and runs the real binary in the finish line's environment shape. I also ran the built binary by hand against its real defaults and saw sign-in redirect to github.com. The fitness rules are fixed in `.taad/fitness.yaml` and pinned by a 143-row corpus, which also matches under Python `re`. Ten mutation runs each turned a target test red. Not run: the finish-line tests (`tests/acceptance` is not in the tree), the race detector (needs cgo), and the real-GitHub browser sign-in (a person's check).

obligations.how: config.TestLoadOwnerIDGrammar feeds every listed refusal plus "5\n", "0x10", "1_000" and accepts "1" and "9223372036854775807"; each refusal must name HBAND_OWNER_GITHUB_ID.

config.TestLoadBaseURL feeds the https and loopback-http forms (and checks origin, callback URL and SecureCookies) and the refused forms (http non-loopback, path, query, fragment, userinfo, relative); server.TestCookieAttributes covers the prefix and Secure result on both bases.

cmd/hband.TestBinary runs the compiled binary: owner 4242 reaches /admin; no-owner and 'octocat' exit 2 within 10 s naming HBAND_OWNER_GITHUB_ID with the marker secret never printed and no 'listening'; with no overrides (and unread HBAND_GITHUB_AUTH_URL/TOKEN_URL set to evil.example) /healthz is 200 and /auth/github/login is 302 to github.com with client_id, redirect_uri, S256 and no scope. The old clause 'API_URL=evil.example still reaches github.com' contradicts design 2; it now exits 2 (TestBinary subtest 'a remote http identity provider is refused').
obligations.replaced_by: HBAND_GITHUB_URL and HBAND_GITHUB_API_URL are accepted only as https or loopback http, anything else exits 2 naming the variable (config.Load), and unread names are ignored.

obligations.how: server.TestOwnerSignInReachesAdmin subtest 'sent to sign-in from /admin/' follows the whole flow from /admin/ through the fake and ends on 200 with the marker and @octocat; the other subtest checks exactly one sessions row with token_hash == hex(sha256(cookie)) != cookie.

server.TestAdminAccessMatrix/anonymous: every adminRoutes path and the listed variants under GET, HEAD and POST; gated paths 303 to login (GET/HEAD) or 403 (POST), no 2xx, no marker, Cache-Control no-store. Cleaned and case classes answer per design 2 (mux redirect, 404) rather than this older all-303 shape, per M1.

server.TestAdminAccessMatrix/non_owner: same routes, variants and methods, every gated path 403 with the explanatory page, never 2xx or the marker; the same session still shows '@somebody' on the home page.
server.TestPinChangeRevokesAdmin mints a session as owner 42, rebuilds the handler on the same DB with owner 43: 403 on /admin/ with no marker, and the home page still shows the account signed in.

server.TestCallbackRefusesBadState: no cookie, 2-part and 4-part cookies, wrong state length, mismatch, error=access_denied, missing and empty code, and the fake's DenyAtAuthorize each give 400, zero token calls, 0 users and 0 sessions rows, OAuth cookie cleared; a genuine-flow control proves the counts are not vacuous.

server.TestCallbackRefusesGitHubFailures: TokenError200, Token500, wrong verifier, User401, UserMissingID, UserIDZero, UserIDString, UserIDFloat and UserEmptyLogin each give 502, the token endpoint was reached, 0 rows, OAuth cookie cleared, no session cookie, no secret in the body.

server.TestStoreErrorDeniesAdmin 'after sign-in': with the store closed /admin is 503 with no marker, GET / is 200 as anonymous with the sign-in anchor, /healthz is 503; the same test also covers the callback and logout moments.

server.TestDeadSessionIsAnonymous (expired via the injected clock, malformed cookies answered 303 even with the store closed while a well-formed one gives 503 as a control, unknown token) and TestSignInRotatesSession (the first cookie is dead after a second sign-in and the token differs).

server.TestLogout: same-origin POST (with and without Sec-Fetch-Site) deletes the row, clears the cookie, 303 to / and the replayed cookie gets 303 to login; cross-site, same-site and Origin https://evil.example give 403 and the session still opens /admin; GET gives 405.

server.TestLoginNextIsLocalOnly runs the full flow for the listed bad next values (//evil.example, backslash forms, %5C/%5c, https and javascript URLs, tab, NUL, space, 513 bytes) and asserts the callback's final Location is '/'; also with the OAuth cookie's next part swapped after login; /admin and /reports/a-b?x=1 are kept verbatim; the gate case /admin/%2e%2e/%5Cevil.example ends on '/'.

go test ./internal/store: TestOpenFreshDatabase (user_version 1, wal, idempotent reopen), TestRefusesNewerSchema (user_version 99, and realMain returns 1 in cmd/hband.TestRealMainRefusesBadConfig), TestUserDeleteCascadesToSessions, TestUsersHasNoStoredOwnerColumn.

TestAdminAccessMatrix pins one outcome per variant class from design 2 for anonymous, non-owner and owner: cleaned //admin/ and /admin/../admin/ redirect to /admin/, //admin to /admin; /ADMIN and /ADMIN/ 404; gated variants and every adminRoutes path per identity; invariant no 2xx, no marker, Location one of /admin, /admin/, /auth/github/login or /auth/github/login?; the owner's marker is a positive control. Observed redirect status is 307 not 301 (go1.27.4); see deviations.

internal/auth/cookies.go is the only cookie writer (setCookie/clearCookie, always HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, no Domain, Secure and __Host- on https, deletions included); rule 'every cookie is written by the one cookie helper' is in fitness.yaml and in the corpus; server.TestCookieAttributes runs on httptest TLS and parses every Set-Cookie from login, each refusal incl. 503, success and logout success/failure.

auth.TestOwnerRouteWithoutProof serves a bare request, a non-owner Viewer, and a Viewer with IsOwner=true but no Owner proof (each 403, zero calls) plus a positive control with the proof (one call, receives the Owner); auth.TestIsOwner tables (0,0), (-1,-1), (42,0), (42,43), (42,42).

Every sign-in control is an anchor (layout.html); server.TestHomeSignInIsAnchor asserts the anchor and no form targeting the login URL; fitness rule 'no sign-in control is ever a form' covers internal/**/templates/** and is in the corpus (15 rows) and the tree scan.

mutation.replace: <form method="get" action="/auth/github/login"><button type="submit">Sign in with GitHub</button></form>

obligations.how: Kept the existing text/template import ban, added alias and dot import patterns to the template.HTML rule (an aliased html/template hides the typed conversion) and a new rule 'site HTML is never built as a Go string literal' (closes the hand-built-markup spelling the critic named). Corpus holds import spellings, the seven typed conversions and markup literals. Before the fix, run against the unedited fitness.yaml, the corpus failed 70 lines: 3 on the escaping rule, 38 because the new rules did not exist, 11 and 17 on the host and redirect rules, 1 for the retired rule still present; after the fix all rows pass and Python re (the engine's matcher) agrees on all 143 text rows with 0 tree violations.

Widened 'no handler derives scheme or host from the request' in place: receiver names r|req|request; Host, TLS, URL.Host, URL.Scheme, Referer(); Header.Get/Values and Header[...] with host|origin|referer in any case, double quote or backtick, spaces allowed. 34 corpus rows (20 fire, 14 quiet incl. exceptions); the 11 failing before the edit now pass.

LocalPath checks the exact emitted string (printable ASCII 0x21..0x7E, <=512 bytes, no backslash or %5c anywhere, one leading '/', url.Parse clean) and SeeOther writes it verbatim; nothing calls http.Redirect (rule in fitness.yaml). TestLoginNextIsLocalOnly adds /./\evil.example, /x/../\evil.example and /admin/../\evil.example and asserts the Location of the callback's final 303, also with a tampered cookie.

migrate.go runs each migration on a separate single-connection *sql.DB: foreign_keys OFF, BEGIN, SQL, foreign_key_check (any row rolls back and names migration and table), user_version, COMMIT, foreign_keys ON deferred, handle closed before the serving pool opens. TestMigrationRebuildKeepsChildRows keeps both sessions across an injected users rebuild; TestRebuildWithForeignKeysOnWouldCascade is the positive control; TestMigrationOrphanFailsOpen and TestServingPoolHasForeignKeys cover the rest.
Same as O-003: config.TestLoadOwnerIDGrammar.

config.TestLoadBaseURL, TestLoadGitHubEndpoints (defaults, loopback and https overrides, refused forms naming the variable) and TestLoadIgnoresUnknownVariables (HBAND_TRUSTED_PROXIES=127.0.0.1 causes no error; Load reads only its own names; unset HBAND_ADDR gives 127.0.0.1:8080).

cmd/hband.TestBinary compiles with CGO_ENABLED=0 and runs the four shapes: finish-line env with requests to https://hband.test rewritten to the port (owner 200 with marker, other ID 403, anonymous 303 to login), no overrides (302 to github.com), HBAND_GITHUB_URL or HBAND_GITHUB_API_URL=http://evil.example (exit 2 naming it), no owner with a marker secret (exit 2 within 10 s, secret never printed). The __Host- cookie jar behaviour behind the rewriting transport worked, confirming the recalled http.Client claim.

server.TestOwnerSignInReachesAdmin and TestHomeSignInIsAnchor: the home page's control is an anchor to /auth/github/login?next=, no form targets it, the flow ends on GET /admin (exact path) 200 with the marker and @octocat, one sessions row, token_hash equals hex(sha256(cookie)).

server.TestAdminAccessMatrix/anonymous per design 2's classes, methods GET, HEAD, POST, plus the long-path boundary rows (slash-dense path gives exactly /auth/github/login; 512-byte login URL keeps next; 513 falls back).
server.TestAdminAccessMatrix/non_owner: every gated path 403 for all three methods, never 2xx or marker; home page still shows '@somebody'.
auth.TestOwnerRouteWithoutProof and auth.TestIsOwner (see O-019).

server.TestPinChangeRevokesAdmin (owner 42 session after rebuild with 43 gets 403 and stays signed in), TestDeadSessionIsAnonymous (expired and malformed give 303 to login, malformed with no DB query), TestSignInRotatesSession.
server.TestCallbackRefusesBadState (400 cases) and TestCallbackRefusesGitHubFailures (502 cases), each with 0 users and 0 sessions rows and the OAuth cookie cleared.

server.TestStoreErrorDeniesAdmin: callback with the store closed 503, no hband_sid Set-Cookie, hband_oauth clear present, 0 rows after reopening; logout 503 with no Set-Cookie and the row kept; after sign-in /admin 503 without marker, GET / 200 anonymous, /healthz 503.
server.TestLogout (same-origin, trusted Origin header, cross-origin 403 with session intact, GET 405, no-session cases).
server.TestLoginNextIsLocalOnly (see O-015), including the gate case and the verbatim cases.

server.TestCookieAttributes: httptest TLS server with an https base collects 5+ clears and 4+ sets from login, a refusal, the 503 callback, success, logout success and failure, all parsed with http.ParseSetCookie to __Host- names with Secure, HttpOnly, Path=/, SameSite=Lax, no Domain, clears Max-Age<0; the loopback http base gives unprefixed names with no Secure.

go test ./internal/store covers every listed row: fresh file, 99 refused (realMain returns 1 in cmd/hband), cascade, no owner column, injected users rebuild keeping both sessions, injected orphan failing Open with user_version unchanged and no row, SignIn rolling back on a duplicate token_hash.

Edited the redirect rule in place: http.Redirect, http.RedirectHandler, any Set/Add of the Location key (quotes or backticks, spaces allowed), Header()["Location"] index writes, the five redirect status constants and numeric 301/302/303/307/308 in WriteHeader; the only excepted non-test file is internal/auth/next.go. Moved the one absolute 302 into next.go as ToProvider (critic's prescription) so handlers.go is not exempt. 34 corpus rows; the 17 failing before the edit now pass.

RequireOwner's loginTarget passes next only when LocalPath accepts the request URI and the escaped login URL also passes; otherwise it answers exactly /auth/github/login. The matrix invariant and gate contract now read 'Location is /admin, /admin/, exactly /auth/github/login, or begins /auth/github/login?'. Matrix rows: 'a/' x200 gives exactly the plain URL; a 512-byte login URL keeps next and next decodes to the request URI; one byte more falls back. Unit test auth.TestLoginTargetFallsBackToPlainLogin.

deviations: The cleaned-variant class (//admin/, /admin/../admin/, //admin) answers 307, not the 301 the design recalled. go1.27.4's net/http/server.go passes StatusTemporaryRedirect at all three mux redirects (lines 2747, 2763, 2772) and the observed response was 307 for GET, HEAD and POST. The matrix pins the observed code through muxCleanStatus; routing was not changed, as the design requires.

The one absolute 302 to GitHub is written by auth.ToProvider in internal/auth/next.go, not directly in github.go or handlers.go as design 2 wrote it. The critic's prescription on m11 (O-043) says to move it so that handlers.go, which holds the callback's 303, is not exempt from the redirect rule. The redirect rule's only non-test exception is next.go.
The new markup-literal rule excepts tests/** as well as _test.go and internal/testutil/**, because the finish-line helpers planted under tests/ are not site code. The critic's text did not list it.

Extra patterns beyond the critic's lists, to close the class: receiver name 'request', r.URL.Host and r.URL.Scheme (an absolute-form request target carries its own), Header.Values and index forms with backtick keys, numeric WriteHeader(301/302/303/307/308), formaction on buttons in the sign-in form rule, and alias/dot imports of html/template.

The retired rule 'the identity provider's endpoints cannot be set from the environment' was removed from .taad/fitness.yaml by name, as design 2 prescribes; the replacement 'read only by the config loader' was already appended. It would otherwise fail config.go on every validate.

server.New returns http.Handler as designed; if AddTrustedOrigin rejects the origin it returns a handler that answers 500, so the failure is closed rather than a panic. config.Load already guarantees a valid origin, so this is unreachable with a loaded Config.

The non-owner 403 page lives in internal/auth/templates/forbidden.html (an embedded html/template in package auth), because RequireOwner is a package-level function used as auth.RequireOwner( by the existing /admin registration rule and cannot take a renderer without changing that spelling.

Standing workaround rule: not applicable. No outside defect is worked around: the backslash and %5c refusals follow the WHATWG URL parser as specified, Lax-not-Strict is SameSite as specified, and the foreign-key runner follows SQLite's documented pragma and rebuild semantics. No settings list or notice was added.
not_built: SC-002 (0002_reports.sql, internal/reports, serveRaw, report admin routes, HBAND_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES) and SC-005 (reader pages, /raw/{slug}, headless-Edge isolation test): later slices per the design's epic parts.

No screens or app launch command declared for measurement: the binary is configured only by HBAND_* environment variables (decided, no flags and no config file), and the declared launch command cannot carry environment variables or a {port} argument, so the engine could not start it. The home, admin and 403 pages were exercised through the real binary and the test suites instead.

The finish-line tests (tests/acceptance/e001_*) are not in the tree, so they were not run; TestBinary reproduces their environment shape (https://hband.test rewritten to a loopback port, HBAND_TRUSTED_PROXIES set, stand-in GitHub, no redirects followed).
The race detector was not run: -race needs cgo and this machine has CGO_ENABLED=0 as the project requires.

The /admin registration rule's lookahead cannot be compiled by Go's regexp, so the Go corpus skips it. It was checked under Python re (the engine's matcher) against the whole tree with 0 violations, but it has no corpus rows.
follow_ups: Declare how the engine can start the app for screen measurement: either a documented launcher that supplies HBAND_* for a scratch run or an engine-side environment for the launch command. Until then the home, admin and 403 pages are unmeasured for readability.
Add a corpus row set for the '/admin route is only ever registered through the one gated mount' rule by running it under Python re, since Go's regexp cannot evaluate its lookahead.
C-008 Reader Site has no path globs: internal/server/home.go and templates/home.html, layout.html belong to it (the 3-edit limit here went to C-001, C-002 and C-009).
The C-002 line says sessions live in an 'HttpOnly Secure cookie'; Secure is on only for an https base URL, and a loopback http base gets plain names. Reword when the record is next edited.

Person's checks already on the backlog still apply: real sign-in against github.com with the OAuth app (PKCE S256, __Host- cookies over https behind the VPS proxy, Sec-Fetch-Site through the proxy) and that the proxy does not cache admin responses.

architecture.why: internal/config/config.go, internal/store/{store,migrate,signin,sessions}.go, cmd/hband/main.go, internal/server/router.go and static/site.css, the fake GitHub under internal/testutil, and the rule corpus under internal/fitnessrules exist and match no block's globs.
internal/auth holds cookies.go, next.go, session.go, owner.go, github.go, handlers.go and templates/forbidden.html: OAuth flow, sessions, owner gate and the cookie and redirect helpers.
admin.go defines the adminRoutes table and the landing handler; admin.html renders the data-hband-admin page.

tests.note: no output; the binary is static as required
ok for cmd/hband, internal/auth, internal/config, internal/fitnessrules, internal/server, internal/store; fakegithub has no tests

TestBinary compiled cmd/hband with CGO_ENABLED=0 and ran 4 subtests: finish-line env shape (owner 200 with marker, another ID 403, anonymous 303), no overrides (302 to github.com), remote http provider (exit 2), no owner (exit 2). TestRealMainRefusesBadConfig ran 7 subtests including exit 1 for user_version 99 and a clean shutdown.

70 failure lines before the fix: 11 on the request-host rule, 17 on the redirect rule, 3 on the escaping rule, 38 because the two new rules did not exist, 1 for the retired rule still present. Run before editing the rules, as the class-closing evidence.

tests.command: go test -count=1 -v ./internal/fitnessrules after editing the rules
tests.note: corpus 143 text rows plus import rows pass; the tree scan passes. First run after the edit failed twice (an alias pattern fired on a plain import, and a comment in handlers.go quoted an angle bracket); both fixed.

tests.command: python -I check.py <repo> (scratch script, real Python re over the corpus and the whole tree including the lookahead /admin rule)
tests.note: 143 rows checked, 0 mismatches; 173 file/rule checks, 0 violations

tests.command: python -I mut.py <repo> (10 mutations, each applied, tested and restored)
tests.note: O-017, O-018, O-019, O-020, O-021, O-022, O-024, O-025, O-043 and O-044 each turned their named test red; files restored and the suite green afterwards
